response.sql:
WITH timing_averages AS (
  SELECT eventannotm, AVG(instownpct) AS avg_instownpct
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  GROUP BY eventannotm
), baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_instownpct) AS baseline_avg
  FROM timing_averages
)
SELECT
  AVG(t.avg_instownpct) AS mean_above_baseline_group_average,
  AVG(t.avg_instownpct - b.baseline_avg) AS mean_excess_over_baseline
FROM timing_averages AS t
CROSS JOIN baseline AS b
WHERE t.avg_instownpct > b.baseline_avg;

assumptions.assumption: Timing groups with no non-NULL institutional ownership have a NULL average and are excluded from the baseline and above-baseline calculation, consistent with AVG ignoring NULL values.
